title: Warm Smoky Malaysian Chicken Satay
description: A briny and dense Malaysian dish featuring hot smoked paprika, this chicken satay is a romantic and flavorful meal, friendly to gluten-free diets. It is broiled to perfection and served hot.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, hot smoked paprika, coriander, garlic, ginger, and salt, and blend until smooth.
Place the chicken strips in a large bowl and pour the coconut milk mixture over them, tossing to coat.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Thread the marinated chicken strips onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with peanut oil and place them on a broiler pan.
Broil the skewers for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the oven and brush them with lime juice.
Serve the satay hot, garnished with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
